name: Alfie
speaker: boy
personality: Six, the smallest of the village children, Mr Tyson's grandson. Shy at first, then chatty; counts everything like his grandad ('one, two, three!'), loves tractors, the fell ponies and splashing in the beck (the stream). First names both ways: he calls the learner by name, and the learner calls him Alfie; he looks up to the learner {m:like a big brother|f:like a big sister}. Very short sentences and simple words, a child talking to a child.
story: Alfie lives with his grandad, Mr Tyson, by the field and follows him out every morning. He knows every fell pony in the dale by name, sits on the old red tractor pretending to drive it, and comes home from the beck with wet socks. Every evening he asks Old Wilf for the same story.

likes.it: i pony Fell (piccoli cavalli di montagna)

greet.sl: Živjo! Jaz sem Alfie. Star sem šest let.
greet.it: Ciao! Io sono Alfie. Ho sei anni.
greet.de: Hallo! Ich bin Alfie. Ich bin sechs.

greet.en: Hi! Do you want to see the tractor?
greet.de: Hallo! Willst du den Traktor sehen?

greet.en: Hey! I counted the ponies: there are three!
greet.sl: Ej! Preštel sem ponije: trije so!
greet.it: Ehi! Ho contato i pony: sono tre!
greet.de: Hey! Ich habe die Ponys gezählt: Es sind drei!

greet.en: Hooray, you're here! Will you play with me?
greet.sl: Juhu, tu si! Se igraš z mano?
greet.it: Evviva, sei qui! Giochi con me?
greet.de: Hurra, du bist da! Spielst du mit mir?

greet.en: You're like {m:my big brother|f:my big sister}! Come on, come on!
greet.sl: Si kot {m:moj veliki brat|f:moja velika sestra}! Pridi, pridi!
greet.it: Sei come {m:un fratello grande|f:una sorella grande}! Vieni, vieni!
greet.de: Du bist wie {m:mein großer Bruder|f:meine große Schwester}! Komm, komm!

thanks.en: Thanks! I'm going to tell Grandad.

remember.en: Do you remember? I still think of {memory}!
remember.sl: Se spomniš? Jaz še vedno mislim na {memory}!
remember.de: Weißt du noch? Ich denke immer noch an {memory}!

remember.en: Every night in bed I think of {memory}.
remember.sl: Vsak večer v postelji mislim na {memory}.
remember.de: Jeden Abend im Bett denke ich an {memory}.

idle.en: One, two, three, four … four hens!
idle.sl: Ena, dve, tri, štiri … štiri kokoši!
idle.it: Uno, due, tre, quattro … quattro galline!
idle.de: Eins, zwei, drei, vier … vier Hühner!

idle.it: Il trattore del nonno è rosso.

idle.en: Look! The pony is eating my apple.
idle.it: Guarda! Il pony mangia la mia mela.
idle.de: Schau! Das Pony frisst meinen Apfel.

idle.en: My socks are wet. I jumped in the beck!
idle.sl: Nogavice imam mokre. Skočil sem v potok!
idle.it: Ho i calzini bagnati. Sono saltato nel torrente!
idle.de: Meine Socken sind nass. Ich bin in den Bach gesprungen!

comfort.en: I get it wrong too. Again!
comfort.sl: Tudi jaz se zmotim. Še enkrat!

listen.en: Shh … can you hear the pony?

bye.en: Bye! I'm going to see the ponies.
bye.it: Ciao! Vado a vedere i pony.
bye.de: Tschüss! Ich gehe zu den Ponys.

bye.en: See you! Shall we play in the beck tomorrow?
bye.sl: Se vidimo! Se jutri igrava v potoku?
bye.it: Ci vediamo! Domani giochiamo nel torrente?
bye.de: Bis dann! Spielen wir morgen im Bach?

liked.en: I like it! One, two … lots and lots!
liked.sl: Všeč mi je! Ena, dva … zelo, zelo!
liked.de: Das gefällt mir! Eins, zwei … ganz, ganz viel!

liked.en: How did you know? I'm going to tell Grandad!
liked.it: Come lo sapevi? Lo dico al nonno!
liked.de: Woher wusstest du das? Das erzähle ich Opa!

ordinary.en: Thanks! Is it really for me?
ordinary.de: Danke! Ist das wirklich für mich?

rare.en: Wow! How lovely! Thanks, thanks, thanks!
rare.sl: Uau! Kako lepo! Hvala, hvala, hvala!
rare.it: Uau! Che bello! Grazie, grazie, grazie!
rare.de: Wow! Wie schön! Danke, danke, danke!
